messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick pre-cutover check for the EU midnight window (02:00 UTC). Freeze starts 01:30 UTC. Plan: pin service -> rollout canary 10% -> 30m watch -> 50/100. Release notes https://redwood.in/release/3.14.2. Can everyone confirm readiness and rollback owner?

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted: pin v3.14.2 -> starting canary on eu1. Canary traffic: 10%. Health checks: running. Logs: /logs/3.14.2/canary

Mike R.: infra capacity looks good for the expected QPS. Autoscaler tested on staging. No known host maintenance in eu1 during window.

Anya Patel: QA smoke started on canary at +2m. Basic flows (chat, embeddings, streaming) executed. Found one flaky streaming timeout on a long stream (p95). Reproducing locally.

James K.: just pushed a tiny infra tweak to reduce connection pooling timeouts (no restart). Change is isolated, shouldn't affect the cutover.

Priya Singh: I own rollback. If canary errors exceed 5% or latency > 800ms p95 for two consecutive 5m buckets, I will trigger rollback and unpin. Ping me in #oncall if I don't ack within 2m.

Nora QA: manual smoke pass completed for embeddings and reranking. Streaming issue Anya saw looks like an edge-case with long sessions; not blocking for canary but adding a regression test.

Leo (infra): DB migration not included in this change, no schema drift. Networking: egress rule change was reverted earlier, so no outstanding firewall changes.

deploy-bot: canary report 00:14: status=healthy, errors=0.6%, p95=420ms, token-rate within expected. Canary metrics: cpu 48%, gpu mem 62%.

Anya Patel: rechecked streaming after minor config tweak — p95 down to 520ms on canary. Not ideal but within our soft SLO for this rollout.

Olivia Chen: Ok — pin confirmed and canary healthy. Rollback owner: @Priya Singh. Oncall: @Mike R. Watch leads: @Anya Patel (QA) and @Leo (infra). Owners list in the release notes, call tree in doc.

release-bot: Release notes snapshot published: https://redwood.in/release/3.14.2/notes. Changelog: performance fixes, streaming retry logic, minor kernel selector tweak.

deploy-bot: advancing canary -> 30% at 00:38 UTC. Starting 30m watch window. Metrics channel: #canary-metrics-3-14-2.

Mike R.: I'll monitor autoscaler and infra dashboards. Will post if any host flapping or queueing appears.

Priya Singh: Confirmed rollback playbook: `rollback v3.14.2` will unpin and shift traffic back to v3.14.1. If triggered, follow step checklist in docs and escalate to Olivia immediately.

Olivia Chen: Final checklist: 1) Pin set (yes). 2) Canary healthy (yes). 3) QA smoke ok (yes). 4) Infra green (yes). 5) Rollback owner and playbook ready (yes). 6) Release notes published (yes). We're GO for the change window. Keep chatter to essential updates only; log all decisions in the release thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout to 50% scheduled at 01:10 UTC if no alerts. Will post update on completion.

Nora QA: leaving a short test matrix in the release doc for post-rollout verification.

Anya Patel: I'll run the extended streaming stress test at +40m into the 30% watch. Will report back with numbers.

Olivia Chen: Thanks team — I'll stay on for the watch. Priya, Mike: standby to execute rollback if thresholds breach.

deploy-bot: last status before watch: canary 30% healthy, errors 0.7%, p95 510ms. No action required.
